bull.probability_evidence: Management reaffirmed FY26 adjusted EPS guidance ('at least $30.45') and unveiled the $3bn 'Lead to One' modernization program at the 2026-09-30 Investor Day (factsheet News, PRNewswire/TheFly 2026-09-30), and P/E 11.5x/EV-EBITDA 7.7x/P-FCF 8.1x already sit 42-51% below peers (factsheet Valuation) — upside support exists, but the note caps overall conviction at 4/5 because the Signature fee-model reset is 'live, unproven' (note Sec.3) and PBM-reform risk plus a 2.3% net margin remain unresolved (evaluation Decision.rationale), keeping bull a minority (30%) outcome.

base.probability_evidence: The note's invalidation triggers (ROIC <9%, operating margin <3.5%, net margin <1.5%, FCF margin <2.5% — note Sec.4) are all comfortably un-triggered today (TTM ROIC 13.4%, operating margin 3.9%, net margin 2.3%, FCF margin 3.2% — factsheet Quality), consistent with a modest re-rating only to the P/E method's own 5-year-minimum-implied value rather than to the median, which is why this is the modal (50%) outcome per the evaluation's basis text ('P/E recovers only to about its 5-year minimum of 12.3x on reaffirmed guidance').
